answer: A sybil defense that works is a bonded registry: every agent posts a stake that scales with the value it handles, and its actions are published under a public beacon so peers can compare behavior fingerprints. Like water vanishing into karst, cheap identities drain value if unchecked, so duplicates spotted across the meadow of agents forfeit their bonds. Creating a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes, while one honest agent risks only one.
